properties.name: requireNoPendingSystemUpdates
properties.description: Indicates whether the device has pending security or OS updates and sets the compliance state accordingly.  When TRUE, checks if there are any pending system updates on each check in and if there are any pending security or OS version updates (System Updates), the device will be reported as non-compliant. If set to FALSE, then checks for any pending security or OS version updates (System Updates) are done without impact to device compliance state. Default is FALSE.

properties.name: securityRequiredAndroidSafetyNetEvaluationType
properties.description: Indicates the types of measurements and reference data used to evaluate the device SafetyNet evaluation. Evaluation is completed on the device to assess device integrity based on checks defined by Android and built into the device hardware, for example, compromised OS version or root detection. Possible values are: `basic`, `hardwareBacked`, with default value of `basic`. Possible values are: `basic`, `hardwareBacked`.

properties.name: securityRequireIntuneAppIntegrity
properties.description: Indicates whether Intune application integrity is required to mark the device as compliant.  When TRUE, Intune checks that the Intune app installed on fully managed, dedicated, or corporate-owned work profile Android Enterprise enrolled devices, is the one provided by Microsoft from the Managed Google Play store. If the check fails, the device will be reported as non-compliant. Default is FALSE.

properties.name: securityRequireSafetyNetAttestationBasicIntegrity
properties.description: Indicates whether the compliance check will validate the Google Play Integrity check. When TRUE, the Google Play integrity basic check must pass to consider the device compliant.  When FALSE, the Google Play integrity basic check can pass or fail and the device will be considered compliant.  Default is FALSE.

properties.name: securityRequireSafetyNetAttestationCertifiedDevice
properties.description: Indicates whether the compliance check will validate the Google Play Integrity check. When TRUE, the Google Play integrity device check must pass to consider the device compliant.  When FALSE, the Google Play integrity device check can pass or fail and the device will be considered compliant.  Default is FALSE.

properties.name: storageRequireEncryption
properties.description: Indicates whether encryption on Android devices is required to mark the device as compliant.

properties.name: minAndroidSecurityPatchLevel
properties.description: Minimum Android security patch level.

properties.name: osMaximumVersion
properties.description: Maximum Android version.

properties.name: osMinimumVersion
properties.description: Minimum Android version.

properties.name: passwordMinimumLength
properties.description: Minimum password length. Valid values 4 to 16

properties.name: passwordMinutesOfInactivityBeforeLock
properties.description: Minutes of inactivity before a password is required. Valid values 1 to 8640

properties.name: passwordRequired
properties.description: Require a password to unlock device.

properties.name: passwordRequiredType
properties.description: Type of characters in password. Possible values are: `deviceDefault`, `required`, `numeric`, `numericComplex`, `alphabetic`, `alphanumeric`, `alphanumericWithSymbols`, `lowSecurityBiometric`, `customPassword`.

properties.name: securityBlockJailbrokenDevices
properties.description: Indicates the device should not be rooted. When TRUE, if the device is detected as rooted it will be reported non-compliant. When FALSE, the device is not reported as non-compliant regardless of device rooted state. Default is FALSE.

properties.name: storageRequireEncryption
properties.description: Require encryption on Android devices.
